source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.15
text: The APPP project's recommended nursery/seedbed (ថ្នាលសំណាប) preparation method: (1) Farmer seed-production groups prepare raised nursery beds about 1.2 m wide, with a 30–50 cm gap/path left between adjacent beds. (2) Spread rice-husk charcoal ash evenly over the bed at roughly 1 basket per 10 m² of bed area; rice-husk ash can also be added if available. (3) Level and smooth the bed surface evenly with water. (4) Sow the pre-germinated seed evenly across the bed. (5) Apply DAP fertilizer (18-46-0) to the bed at a rate of about 9 grams per m². (6) Because seedlings on the nursery bed grow quickly and need extra nitrogen, the project also recommends a follow-up application of urea to the nursery bed.
